name: C1.2 real Mamba reproduction on GPUs 0-3
purpose: Reproduce the Item162 real pretrained Mamba C1.2 flip verification independently on GPUs 0, 1, 2, and 3 after restoring the item log after 132. Each GPU runs the same state-spaces/mamba-130m-hf M1/M2 checkpoint-restore depth sweep.

code_added_used.change: Standalone reproduction runner for the Item162 real pretrained Mamba checkpoint restore test. It deep-copies the Transformers DynamicCache plus current logits for M2, uses a truncation/reset cache baseline for M1, and records a state tensor audit.

commands.command: uv venv .venv --python python && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python 'torch>=2.1.0' 'transformers>=4.40.0' huggingface_hub safetensors
commands.purpose: Create a local ignored reproduction environment because the old checkout did not include .venv and the system Python lacked transformers.

commands.command: for gpu in 0 1 2 3; do CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$gpu .venv/bin/python -m analysis.c1_2_reproduce_mamba --device cuda:0 --cuda-visible-devices $gpu --output results/c1_2_architecture_restore_characterization/item162_repro_gpu0_3_20260620/gpu${gpu}_real_mamba_depth_sweep.json & done; wait
commands.purpose: Run four independent real Mamba checkpoint restore reproductions on GPUs 0-3 without killing or preempting any process.
Print and verify the per-GPU reproduction summaries.

provenance.gpu_policy: free capacity only; no running process was killed or preempted
provenance.dependency_note: .venv is local/ignored and is not part of the committed artifacts.

decision.headline: GPU0-3 independently reproduce Item162: M2 exact full-state snapshot, M1 truncation fails, C1.2 flip remains locked.

gate_outcomes.number: On every GPU, M2 has resume_divergence_max=0.0 and decision_agreement=1.0 for depths 1,8,32,128.
On every GPU, M1 has nonzero divergence and decision_agreement below 1.0 across the depth sweep.

decision.next_step_routing: Use Item163 as the GPU0-3 reproduction confirmation for the Item162 C1.2 flip lock. Part 5 and Part 6 may resume only when explicitly requested.

honesty.reproduction_scope: This item reproduces Item162 on GPUs 0-3 using the same real pretrained Mamba checkpoint and depth sweep. It does not add a new architecture family.
honesty.artifact_scope: Large per-GPU JSON outputs are under results/ and may be ignored by git; the item records their local paths and summaries.
honesty.environment_scope: A local .venv was created because this checkout lacked one; it is intentionally not committed.
